topic: Kaun bola Meow Meow (Guess the funny animal)
format: mystery box surprise reveal with countdown and tap tap sound
title_hi: कौन बोला म्याऊं म्याऊं? मस्ती भरा जादुई खेल!
title_en: Who said Meow Meow? Funny Magic Box Surprise!
description: Join Chintu elephant and Mithu parrot in a fun guessing game to find the hidden animal. Perfect for toddlers and preschoolers! #Shorts #KidsRhymes #Cartoon
learning: Animal sound recognition and identifying hidden objects.

scenes.text: Arrey! Magic box ke andar kaun chhupa hai?
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 CGI render, a bright yellow colorful magic box sitting in a lush green park, Chintu the orange baby elephant with blue scarf looking at it with big curious sparkly eyes, bright daylight.

scenes.text: Mithu, jaldi se tap tap karo!
scenes.image_prompt: Mithu the green parrot with a red cap flying towards the magic box, tiny wings flapping, expressive happy face, vibrant 3D cartoon style.

scenes.text: Tap! Tap! Tap! Let's count one, two, three!
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of the magic box, sparkling magical dust rising from the lid as it starts to shake, vibrant colors, 3D render.
The magic box lid flying open with a pop, Chintu elephant covering his eyes with his trunk in excitement, confetti and sparkles everywhere.

scenes.text: Oh look! It is a tiny white kitty cat!
scenes.image_prompt: A cute fluffy white kitten jumping out of the magic box with a playful expression, 3D style, soft lighting.

scenes.text: Kaun bola Meow Meow? Kya ye billi hai?
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu and Mithu looking at the kitten, Chintu laughing, kitten doing a cute dance, high-energy kids animation style.

scenes.text: Hahaha! Bilkul sahi! Meow Meow Meow!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu and Mithu dancing together with the kitten, colorful background with balloons, joyful expressions, celebratory vibe.

scenes.text: Ruko! Magic box mein phir se dekho...
scenes.image_prompt: The kitten winking at the camera and hopping back into the box, Chintu looking at the camera with a curious finger on his chin, loop-ready frame.
